The copy is duplicated across the frame in a dense, evenly spaced grid, creating a noise-like pattern rather than a legible paragraph. There are no other visual elements, illustrations, or color variations — the effect is a clean, modern typographic backdrop that reads as texture at a distance and as repeating text up close. Ideal as a neutral, brand-safe background layer or stylized overlay in motion graphics.
assets.useCase: Works as a loopable background plate or overlay in a short reel shot — pan or subtle parallax/zoom for motion, lower-third backing for text, title cards, transitions, or experimental glitch/typographic animations.

assets.title: Resume Review Workspace Tie
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic shot of a tidy wooden desk staged for a professional/resume review scene. Foreground shows a neat stack of printed resume-style pages with a black pen resting on top. To the right lies a navy, speckled necktie partially in frame. Midground contains a ceramic coffee mug filled with black coffee, a closed black notebook, and a small potted plant. Background features a silver laptop with a dark screen and visible keyboard. Warm, soft lighting and natural wood grain create a calm, focused mood; neutral color palette with navy accent and metallic laptop tones.
assets.useCase: Short-reel B-roll for job search, interview prep, resume tips, professional morning routine, or career coaching segments.

assets.title: Retail Counter Paper Bags Pos Terminal
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical shot of a retail checkout counter featuring eco-friendly kraft paper packaging: two stacked cardboard boxes and a standing paper shopping bag with twisted handles. A black card payment terminal with a blank white screen sits in the foreground on a polished marble countertop that has a wooden slat front. The background is softly blurred (bokeh) showing potted plants and warm, backlit shelving with neutral decor, creating a cozy, minimalist retail interior atmosphere.
assets.useCase: Short reel B-roll or opener showing a checkout/packaging moment for retail, e-commerce, sustainable packaging promos, or payment UX scenes; works as a 1–3s establishing shot or transition in promotional videos.

assets.title: Revenue Growth Usd Gradient
assets.detailedDescription: Square PNG icon with transparent background showing three ascending rounded bars (left to right) in a blue gradient, a curved upward arrow sweeping from lower-left to upper-right, and a circular coin with a bold black dollar sign positioned top-left. The design is flat 2D with smooth rounded shapes, a cool blue-to-indigo gradient on the bars and arrow, and high contrast on the dollar symbol for legibility.
assets.useCase: Overlay or cut-in icon in short reels to signal revenue or sales growth — ideal for product demos, analytics dashboards, financial slides, app UI highlights, and end-screen CTAs about profit improvements.

assets.title: Right Arrow Circle Gray
assets.detailedDescription: A compact PNG icon showing a centered right-pointing triangular arrow (play/forward glyph) inside a circular button. The circle uses a neutral gray tonal palette with a subtle inner shadow/gradient that gives slight depth while remaining a flat, minimal visual. The triangle is a solid, high-contrast silhouette relative to the ring. The asset is designed for UI and video overlays and appears optimized for clear legibility at small sizes on light or dark backgrounds (transparent background).
assets.useCase: Use as an on-screen overlay or UI control in a short reel: play/forward/next button, transition marker between clips, navigation CTA in app mockups, or microinteraction icon in video players.

assets.title: Ring Light Tabletop Tripod Phone Mount
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic product-style icon of a circular LED ring light mounted on a compact tabletop tripod with an adjustable smartphone holder centered in the ring. The lamp emits a warm white glow, surrounded by a matte black frame, visible power cable, and precise mechanical knobs on the tripod. The scene is front-on and vertically oriented against a neutral gray gradient background with soft studio shadows and high contrast, emphasizing the ring's illumination and the textured metal hardware.
assets.useCase: Centered close-up prop in short-form reels or tutorial intros — ideal as B-roll or overlay when illustrating vlogging setups, livestream announcements, makeup tutorials, or content-creation gear.

assets.title: Ring Light Tripod Icon 3d
assets.detailedDescription: High-quality 3D-render icon of a circular LED ring light mounted on a compact tabletop tripod with an integrated phone holder. The ring emits a warm white glow through a smooth diffuser; the hardware is matte black with visible adjustment knobs and a thin power cable. Isolated on a neutral gradient background with soft shadows for depth.
assets.useCase: Use as a short-reel close-up or overlay to signify creator gear, lighting tips, unboxing or setup scenes for vlogs, tutorials, streaming intros/outros, or product highlight shots.

assets.title: Rounded Browser Window Frame Glossy
assets.detailedDescription: High-resolution icon of a minimalist browser window frame rendered with photorealistic lighting. The frame features a slim, light-gray title bar with three circular control buttons (red, yellow, green) in the top-left, rounded corners, a subtle inner bevel, and a bright white content pane with a central dark vignette. The window sits on a metallic, vertically-striped dark-gray background with a soft outer glow and shadow, giving the asset depth and a floating appearance. Transparent or empty content area makes it suitable as an overlay for screenshots and video mockups.
assets.useCase: Use as an overlay frame in short reel shots to present app screenshots, web previews or product demos; works for transitions, mockup reveals, and tutorial callouts where a realistic browser window is needed.

assets.title: Rounded Gradient Bulleted List Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A flat UI icon showing a rounded-square tile filled with a diagonal purple-to-pink gradient background. Centered on the tile is a bold black list glyph composed of three circular bullet points aligned vertically on the left and three rounded horizontal bars to the right representing list items. The glyph uses thick, rounded strokes and strong contrast against the vibrant gradient, creating a modern, attention-grabbing control suitable for app toolbars, menus, or CTA buttons.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI/menu or CTA icon in a short reel shot: pop in for app navigation, indicate a tasks/checklist screen, or appear as an animated button in an interface close-up.

assets.title: Rounded Label Left Circle Checkbox
assets.detailedDescription: A minimalist UI icon showing a wide, horizontal rounded rectangle label in bright white with a very thin gray outline and soft drop shadow. On the left edge of the label is a single circular checkbox outline (unselected) slightly inset from the label edge. The composition sits on a vertical brushed-metal gray gradient background with subtle vertical streaks and a gentle halo around the label, giving a slight skeuomorphic depth while retaining a clean, modern look.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI row or checklist element in short reel shots: appear as an overlay label that fades in while text is typed or the circular checkbox animates to checked during a quick app/demo sequence.

assets.title: Rounded Multicolor People Group
assets.detailedDescription: Flat, stylized icon of nine faceless human figures arranged in a 3x3 grid. Each figure is composed of a rounded head and a simple torso with thick black outlines, soft pastel shirt colors (red, purple, green, yellow, blue) and neutral skin tones. Subtle glossy highlights on heads and shoulders give a slight sheen; background is transparent and the asset is square (512x512).
assets.useCase: Use as a cut-in or overlay to represent a team, community, audience, or user group in short reels, onboarding screens, team slides, or UI mockups.

assets.title: Rounded White Glow Card Small
assets.detailedDescription: A horizontal, rounded-corner white paper card centered on a dark, vertically brushed gray background. The card has a soft outer glow halo, a subtle paper-like grain, and a faint drop shadow that lifts it off the background; edges show a gentle bevel and smooth 12px radius corners. High-contrast vignette and vertical gradient stripes behind the card give a studio-lit, minimal look suitable for overlays and UI mockups.
assets.useCase: Use as a foreground card or placeholder in short reel shots for titles, lower-thirds, CTAs, UI mockups, or product info overlays where a clean neutral background is needed.

assets.title: Route Pins Connected Gradient
assets.detailedDescription: Minimal line-icon showing two hollow location pins connected by a single curved path. The entire graphic is a smooth, rounded stroke with a warm gradient from yellow through orange to red, set on a transparent background. Each pin has a circular center and a ring-shaped base; the connecting path is slightly tapered and organic, giving a sense of motion and direction.
assets.useCase: Overlay or UI element in short reels to show a journey, route between two points, pickup/dropoff, navigation step, or a transition in travel and delivery app scenes.

assets.title: Rupee Coin Growth Stacks Vertical
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic 3D-render close-up of five ascending stacks of gold/bi-metal rupee coins placed on a wooden tabletop. Each stack increases left-to-right and holds a small beige card displaying a rising bar chart. Warm, directional sunlight creates soft highlights and long, gentle shadows; the background is a smooth, neutral brown bokeh with a blurred green potted plant at the right edge. The composition uses shallow depth of field, natural reflections on coin edges, and a vertical phone-friendly frame.
assets.useCase: Short reel intro or transition illustrating savings, investment growth, revenue rise — ideal for a left-to-right pan or a quick zoom-out showing increasing returns.

assets.title: Rupee Coin Stack 3d Gold Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Portrait-oriented 3D-render of a polished gold coin stack embossed with the Indian rupee (₹) symbol. Several coins float or spin above the stacked pile, showing ridged edges, beveled rims and high-gloss reflections. Warm gold gradient background fades into a dark lower area with subtle vignette and two faint white camera-framing corner marks near the bottom—leaving negative space for text or UI overlays. Studio-style lighting creates bright highlights and soft shadowing, producing a luxurious, high-contrast look suitable for finance and investment visuals.
assets.useCase: Hero/frame in a short reel or app promo to represent rupee gains, investments or savings; ideal as a thumbnail, transition shot, or background for lower-third text/CTA.

assets.title: Rupee Coins Calculator Notebook Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic close-up of a tidy wooden desk focused on stacks and loose two-tone Indian rupee coins in the foreground. Midground shows a black calculator, a spiral notebook with a pen, and a leather wallet. A ceramic coffee mug sits to the right; a potted plant and sunlit window are visible out of focus in the background alongside a framed abstract print. Warm natural sunlight creates soft highlights on the coin edges and wood grain; shallow depth of field produces a strong foreground focus with creamy bokeh behind.
assets.useCase: Establishing or cutaway close-up for a finance or budgeting reel — use as the opening shot for money-saving tips, expense breakdowns, bill-paying tutorials, or transitions to on-screen calculations.

assets.title: Rupee Coins Kraft Envelope Calculator
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical desk still showing a small stack and scattered Indian rupee bimetallic coins beside an open kraft paper envelope with a visible slip, a black calculator with large buttons at the lower right, a leather wallet at top-right, a pen and blank notepad at lower-left, and a small potted plant at upper-left. Soft, warm neutral lighting and shallow depth of field create gentle shadows and a calm, organized budgeting or bookkeeping mood. Composition is angled top-down and optimized for mobile/vertical reels.
assets.useCase: Close-up B-roll for a short reel or app onboarding scene about budgeting, cash-envelope method, bill payments, or small-business bookkeeping—works as an opening or cutaway shot.

assets.title: Rupee Neumorphic Dark Fintech Dashboard
assets.detailedDescription: A moody, dark glass UI composition featuring multiple dashboard cards arranged in a grid. Large left cards display upward-trending line charts with glowing data points and vertical bar charts; right-side stacked cards include a profile/info card with a notification bell, a compact circular-metric card, and a smaller trend widget with an arrow. Palette centers on deep charcoal and black backgrounds with warm gold highlights and cool cyan accents; subtle vignette, soft glow around key data points, rounded card corners, and a faint textured grain give a premium 3D-rendered, neumorphic look. An Indian rupee symbol appears on the main chart, indicating regional finance context.
assets.useCase: 2–4s b-roll or overlay in a fintech product reel: close-up on analytics while narrating growth, transition shot for investor pitches or app intro screens.

assets.title: Rupee Stack Coins Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Flat-style PNG icon depicting a small stack of gold rupee coins, each coin showing a clear ₹ glyph. The design uses warm gold/yellow gradients, subtle highlights and a soft drop shadow to create depth while retaining a clean, crisp silhouette on a transparent background. Centered composition and high contrast make it suitable for overlays, UI elements and short animated video clips.
assets.useCase: Short 1–3s reel overlay or UI micro-interaction to indicate incoming payments, balance updates, earnings, rewards or transaction success; works as a notification badge, onboarding visual, or animated element in finance/productivity videos.

assets.title: Salary Rupee Growth Report Icon
assets.detailedDescription: High-detail 3D-render icon of a stacked paper report clipped at the top by a blue binder ring, shown at a slight oblique perspective. The document surface includes muted gray text lines and a blue ascending bar chart; a polished golden coin embossed with the Indian rupee symbol overlaps the upper right of the page and emits a small sparkle highlight. A curved gold arrow rises from the chart toward the coin, conveying growth; subtle paper curl on the bottom sheet, metallic reflections, soft vignette background and drop shadow give the asset depth and a premium, glossy look.
assets.useCase: Use as a compact UI or reel shot icon for salary/payroll updates, earnings growth, HR dashboard callouts, financial reports or fintech app thumbnails and transitions.

assets.title: Salary Wallet Gradient Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Square app-style icon on a rounded-corner canvas featuring a centered, flat-style wallet and cash/coin motif. The background is a smooth purple → magenta gradient within a rounded square; the wallet and monetary elements use warm orange and yellow accents for strong contrast. Design is minimal and geometric with clean edges, subtle inner shadows and a small highlight to imply a slight layered or raised look. No text, 1:1 composition, optimized for UI/video overlays and small-scale thumbnails.
assets.useCase: Short reel shot: appear during a transition or as an overlay when introducing salary, payroll, payments, or compensation topics — works as a thumbnail, lower-third badge, or animated pop-in icon.

assets.title: Save Money Wallet Blue Gradient
assets.detailedDescription: Clean, modern flat icon of a rounded rectangular wallet with a side flap and circular button detail. A large coin with a dollar sign is partially inserted into the top of the wallet. The graphic uses a cyan-to-violet linear gradient fill with bold, rounded black outline strokes, high contrast and crisp edges. Square 1:1 composition, export-ready for UI use and short reel animation overlays (512×512 source-style).
assets.useCase: Ideal as a UI icon or animated overlay in short product reels: appears in savings/budget screens, CTAs like 'Save' or 'Add Funds', onboarding clips, or explainer sequences about finances.

assets.title: Scribble Oval Gray Badge
assets.detailedDescription: Centered hand-drawn scribble oval badge on a cool metallic gray vertical-gradient background. The badge is formed by multiple overlapping thin charcoal strokes creating an uneven, sketch-like scalloped ring with an empty center suitable for overlays. Subtle shading and faint vignette on the background give a soft sense of depth while keeping the asset minimal and desaturated.
assets.useCase: Use as a quick reel overlay or thumbnail accent to circle and highlight an on-screen element, act as a badge placeholder for numbers/text, or animate the scribble as a reveal when calling out features in short video shots.

assets.title: Server Room Cloud Network Monitor
assets.detailedDescription: Portrait-oriented photorealistic shot of a dimly lit data center workspace. A desktop monitor in the midground displays a neon electric-blue cloud network diagram: one large central cloud node connected by glowing circuitry lines to several smaller clouds. In the foreground a keyboard, mouse and coffee mug sit on a dark desk, softly lit by the monitor. The background shows blurred server racks with multicolored status LEDs and deep blue ambient lighting, creating strong depth of field and cinematic bokeh. High contrast, cool color palette and reflective surfaces emphasize a modern, secure IT environment.
assets.useCase: Establishing or cutaway shot in a short tech reel to represent cloud infrastructure, network monitoring, or data center operations; works as a hero background for titles, voiceover segments, or app/service intros.

assets.title: Shopping Bags Gradient Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A clean flat icon of two overlapping shopping bags rendered with a smooth blue-to-purple vertical gradient fill and bold black outline strokes. The composition shows a taller bag positioned behind a shorter bag in the foreground, each with rounded double handles anchored by circular rivets. The right side of the rear bag displays a stylized folded base crease for dimension. The icon is isolated on a transparent background, optimized for UI use at multiple sizes and suitable for PNG or vector export.
assets.useCase: Works as a foreground overlay or CTA in short ecommerce reels—ideal for product-collection transitions, sale or promo callouts, checkout flow animations, and app/store UI intros.

assets.title: Shopping Cart Cyan Purple Gradient
assets.detailedDescription: A flat 2D shopping cart icon rendered as a bold outline with rounded stroke ends. The basket is depicted with a six-cell grid pattern and a forward-right tilt, sitting on two circular wheels and a single angled handle. The entire shape is filled with a smooth left-to-right cyan-to-purple linear gradient, creating a modern neon look. Clean vector-style edges, high contrast on transparent background, optimized for UI overlays, buttons, and motion graphics.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI overlay or button in short reels: appears during add-to-cart animations, checkout callouts, storefront previews, or quick product demo transitions; works well as a badge or motion target in mobile app and web UI shots.

assets.title: Silhouette Man On Balcony Sunset City Skyline
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical, photorealistic portrait of a young man seen from behind standing on a balcony at sunset. The subject is backlit, rendered as a soft silhouette against a warm golden-hour sky with scattered clouds. A distant city skyline and low-rise buildings sit on the horizon, gently blurred with mild bokeh; the sun is near the horizon casting orange and amber tones across the scene. Foreground elements include potted plants and a balcony railing that create depth and lead the eye toward the skyline. The composition uses a telephoto feel with shallow depth of field, emphasizing mood and atmosphere rather than facial detail. Ideal for emotive, contemplative sequences and cinematic B-roll.
assets.useCase: Use as a short reel opener or closing B-roll shot for lifestyle, mindfulness, real estate or city-living promos; works well as a transition/establishing clip to set reflective, cinematic tone.

assets.title: Silver Laptop Mockup Frame Centered
assets.detailedDescription: High-resolution photorealistic front-facing laptop mockup. The asset shows a centered silver aluminum laptop with a large dark-gray empty screen, thin black bezels, a subtle top-center webcam dot, visible black chiclet keyboard and trackpad. Lighting creates soft rim highlights along the aluminum edges and a gentle vignette on a neutral vertical-gradient gray background. Composition is symmetrical and tightly cropped to emphasize the screen area as a replaceable mockup frame for inserting UI, screenshots, or animations.
assets.useCase: Use as a hero mockup frame in a short reel for app or website demos — place the screen content (UI, video, or screenshot) into the empty display, then animate a zoom/slide or quick screen-reveal transition for a product showcase or marketing CTA.

assets.title: Single Eighth Note Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A clean, monochrome flat icon depicting a single eighth (quaver) musical note centered on a transparent background. The note is rendered as a solid black silhouette with crisp edges and consistent stroke weight for legibility at small sizes. The composition is balanced within a square frame, making it ready to use as a UI element, overlay, or motion-graphics asset. PNG with anti-aliased edges suitable for scaling in video projects and easy color replacement in post.
assets.useCase: Used as a UI/media overlay or badge in short reels—appears as play/listen button, intro/outro accent, playlist marker, or transition icon to signal music/audio content.

assets.title: Small Business Invoice Desk Portrait
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical, high-resolution photograph of a tidy wooden desk staged for small-business paperwork and fulfillment. Foreground shows a clipboard stack with blank invoice/order forms and a black pen resting on top; additional printed forms and a notebook with a second pen sit nearby. Left side features a closed laptop with a dark screen; right side shows a calculator and a neat stack of brown cardboard shipping boxes. A small potted plant and a black mesh pen holder occupy midground, with shelving and more boxes softly blurred in the background. Warm natural light casts soft shadows and highlights the wood grain; the composition uses shallow depth of field for a professional, calm workspace aesthetic.
assets.useCase: B-roll or insert shot in a short reel illustrating small-business invoicing, e-commerce order processing, bookkeeping, or a packaging/shipping workflow; suitable as an establishing or cutaway shot in tutorials and explainer videos.

assets.title: Smartphone Tripod Cardboard Box Studio Shot
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic studio shot showing a tabletop content-creation setup: a smartphone mounted on a small black tripod at left filming a plain kraft cardboard product box centered on a round textured pedestal. A large softbox with grid sits at the top-right, casting soft warm light and gentle shadows. Background features warm backlit shelving and blurred plants, producing a shallow depth of field and soft bokeh. Neutral beige and wood tones dominate the palette, creating a minimal, modern lifestyle/product photography mood ideal for vertical social reels.
assets.useCase: Short vertical reel hero shot for product reveal, packaging showcase, e-commerce B-roll, influencer unboxing teaser, or social ad creative with room for text overlays.

assets.title: Smiling Bearded Man Purple Vneck
assets.detailedDescription: Head-and-shoulders flat icon of a smiling bearded man with purple hair and beard, light peach skin tone, rosy cheeks, closed crescent eyes and a wide white toothy smile. He wears a blue V-neck shirt; ears and a short neck are visible. The design uses simple geometric shapes, solid colors, minimal shading and clean edges on a transparent background, optimized for use as an avatar or UI icon.
assets.useCase: Works as a friendly user avatar or team/profile icon in short reel shots for onboarding, About/team segments, testimonial overlays, chat/support badges, and intro lower-thirds.

assets.title: Social Media Mobile Engagement Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Flat vector icon showing a faceless person holding a smartphone positioned to the right of an oversized mobile UI. The large phone frame (dark navy) displays a search bar with a yellow highlight, a central pink circular play button, reaction icons (pink heart, thumbs-up), and placeholder text lines. A teal chat bubble with three dots overlaps the left edge of the phone, and a small purple square badge with a stylized 'f' floats to the top-right. The character wears a purple jacket and pink shirt; the palette is bright and playful with high contrast and rounded shapes.
assets.useCase: Quick cut-in or overlay in a short reel to represent social media engagement, app feature demos, onboarding steps, or promotional thumbnails highlighting video/content interaction.

assets.title: Soft Paper Card Large White Glow
assets.detailedDescription: A large, rounded-rectangle paper-style UI card centered on a dark brushed-metal background. The card is bright white with a subtle paper grain texture, very soft beveled edges and a faint drop shadow. A soft halo glow surrounds the card at the top and sides, creating a gentle high-contrast separation from the vertically streaked gray-to-black gradient backdrop. The composition is minimal and neutral, optimized as a reusable UI panel or placeholder.
assets.useCase: Serves as a hero UI card or modal/placeholder in a short reel shot — ideal for overlaying headlines, CTAs, product images, or onboarding copy.

assets.title: Soft Shadow Plate Gray Gradient
assets.detailedDescription: A soft, diffuse oval shadow plate on a brushed metallic gray surface. The composition centers on a dark, smooth vignette that gradually fades to lighter grays toward the edges. Fine vertical streaks create a subtle brushed-metal texture and slight banding, giving the plate a tactile, neutral appearance. Overall the asset is low-contrast, cool-toned and minimal — intended as a muted backdrop or elevation base for icons, UI cards, product mockups, and overlays.
assets.useCase: Insert as a soft backdrop beneath floating icons, UI cards, or product shots in a short reel to add subtle depth during transitions and close-ups.

assets.title: Speaker Gradient Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Transparent-background flat speaker icon made of three geometric elements: a rounded rectangular backplate at left, a large right-pointing rounded-triangle cone in the center, and a short semicircular sound 'wave' at the far right. The entire silhouette is filled with a vivid diagonal gradient shifting from cyan/sky-blue (top-right) to magenta/purple (bottom-left). The shapes have soft rounded corners, a narrow negative-space gap between the backplate and cone, no outlines, and a clean, high-contrast appearance optimized for UI and video overlays.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI overlay or button in short video reels to indicate audio on/unmute, volume controls, media player state, or as a clickable CTA prompting viewers to enable sound.

assets.title: Speaker Volume Waves
assets.detailedDescription: Circular UI icon with a smooth purple-to-lilac radial gradient background. Centered is a rounded, yellow speaker shape with a small orange-red circular accent at the speaker opening. Two thick, curved yellow sound-wave marks radiate to the right. The icon uses bold, rounded geometry, soft inner shading and subtle drop shadowing to create a slightly dimensional, playful flat look suitable for app toolbars or overlays.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI icon or overlay in short reels for indicating audio on/unmute, volume controls, media playback states, in-app notifications, or tutorial callouts about sound.

assets.title: Split Tone Stationery Mockup
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical mockup showing two identical blank portrait cards placed side-by-side on a center seam that divides the frame into a cool dark left half and a warm sunlit right half. Left side: black marble tabletop and dark textured wall, low-key lighting, soft shadow, ceramic planter with a green leafy plant visible on the far left. Right side: warm brown marble tabletop and beige plaster wall with soft sunlight and botanical shadow patterns, a ribbed ceramic vase with dried stems and a small stack of books on the far right. Both cards are off-white textured paper, positioned on the foreground, equal distance from the seam, creating a balanced symmetrical composition for easy content placement.
assets.useCase: A short reel shot for stationery or branding reveals: use the left/right split to show two design variants, before/after comparisons, seasonal colorways, or to place animated text/logo overlays on either card for product or invitation showcases.

assets.title: Stacked Analytics Report Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Flat, colorful vector icon showing a stack of orange report pages set against a circular deep-blue backdrop. The front page displays multiple infographic elements — a multicolored vertical bar chart across the top, a segmented donut/pie chart on the left, short horizontal text lines and colored blocks on the right — all rendered in bold, rounded flat shapes and bright accent colors (blue, red, yellow, green, orange). The composition conveys multi-page analytics, summary reports, and dashboard-style data at a glance.
assets.useCase: Intro thumbnail or overlay in a short reel showcasing dashboard summaries, KPI reports, product analytics features, or transitions between data-driven scenes.

assets.title: Stacked Bimetal Coins Growth Chart

Behind the stacks are five white rectangular bar silhouettes forming a bar chart, topped by a white zig-zag arrow pointing up and to the right. The background is a warm brown gradient with soft, even lighting and shallow depth of field; the foreground coins have visible rim lighting and crisp edge detail. Large negative space above the chart allows for text or overlays.
assets.useCase: Use as a vertical hero shot or background in short reel clips or social ads to illustrate rising profits, investment growth, savings milestones, or to serve as a backdrop for an end-screen CTA; ideal for animating coins rising or overlaying growth metrics.

assets.title: Stacked Checked List Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A flat UI icon showing two stacked checklist items: on the left are two rounded-square checkboxes with white check marks, and on the right are paired groups of three horizontal pill-shaped text placeholders representing list lines. The top checkbox uses a light cyan-to-sky-blue gradient, while the bottom checkbox shifts to a deeper blue-to-violet gradient. All elements have soft rounded corners, generous spacing between the two rows, and a transparent background suitable for overlaying on app screens or UI mockups.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI/UX overlay or cutaway in a short reel to represent completed tasks, a todo-list feature reveal, checklist confirmation, or app onboarding step; pairs well with a quick check animation and transition to a content screen.

assets.title: Stacked Coins Uptrend Arrow
assets.detailedDescription: Flat vector-style icon showing three ascending stacks of gold coins (left to right) topped with large round coins imprinted with dollar signs. A thick, rounded green zigzag arrow rises from the lower-left to the upper-right, visually intersecting or passing behind the stacks to indicate upward financial momentum. Colors are warm gold/yellow for coins and a medium green for the arrow; the shapes are rounded, filled, and outline-free, with a clean, minimal composition and a transparent or neutral background suitable for overlay use.
assets.useCase: Overlay or callout in short finance reels to illustrate revenue growth, profit increases, investment returns, or positive financial trends—suitable for dashboard highlights, end frames, or animated transitions.

assets.title: Stacked Columns Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A high-contrast flat icon: a white geometric glyph of three stacked vertical rectangular columns centered inside a black rounded-square tile. The composition has generous inner padding, crisp edges, no gradients, and a bold minimalist look designed for UI, dashboards, and technology-themed video overlays or lower thirds.
assets.useCase: Use as a tech or infrastructure UI/icon in short reels — e.g., app demos, dashboard transitions, lower-thirds, or animated overlays about servers/storage.

assets.title: Stacked Financial Reports Pen Calculator Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Close-up, vertical photograph of a wooden office desk covered with stacked printed financial reports and charts. A silver metal pen rests on top of the papers showing a visible pie chart and bar graph. A standard calculator sits in the lower-right foreground; a blurred pen holder, small potted plant, folders and a warm desk lamp are visible in the softly focused background. The image uses shallow depth of field and warm, directional lamp lighting to emphasize the documents and tools used for accounting or budgeting.
assets.useCase: Short reel B-roll or transition shot to introduce accounting, bookkeeping, budgeting, tax or financial analysis segments — works as an establishing close-up or overlay background for animated text or voiceover.

assets.title: Stacked Invoice 3d Icon
assets.detailedDescription: High-resolution 3D-render icon of a stacked invoice pad viewed at a slight diagonal tilt. The top sheet is labeled 'INVOICE' in a bold sans-serif heading and contains a minimal, grid-style invoice layout with placeholder lines and boxes for bill-to, description, quantity, price and total. The paper stack shows layered edges and realistic thickness. Lighting is soft with a subtle rim highlight and gentle drop shadow on a neutral gray gradient background, giving a clean, professional, print-ready appearance. Text on the form is intentionally minimal and low-contrast to preserve a generic template look.
assets.useCase: Short reel shot to represent billing, invoicing or payment steps — ideal for a transition or close-up in an explainer video, app onboarding flow, billing summary scene, or finance product promo where a document or receipt visual is needed.

assets.title: Stacked Invoice Paper 3d Render

assets.title: Warm Beige Books Background Portrait
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic background showing a warm beige paper-textured scene with soft directional light. Blurred stacks of books sit on the left and right edges, with an open book fanned at the bottom right and left. Decorative paper-curve borders at the top and bottom incorporate subtle gold flecks and circular line accents. The center is intentionally empty, offering a wide clean copy space with a shallow depth-of-field and gentle bokeh highlights. Overall mood is cozy, nostalgic and elegant, suitable for overlays and title cards.

assets.title: Web Design Code Icon
